title: dortmanna ocimoides
intro: Dortmanna ocimoides, commonly known as the Water Clover, is a perennial aquatic plant that thrives in shallow water environments. The Water Clover is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may also aid in protecting against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the Water Clover include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
